name: stratless
description: Give your AI coding assistant a model of who you are, read from your own history, so it stops making you feel stupid. Local, private, no account.
//: The npm page is where a stranger lands, and this package asks to read their entire
//1: conversation history. Without these three links it would ask for that trust while
//2: showing no source at all. The line count IS the argument — so point at the lines.
//dep: THE ONE RUNTIME DEPENDENCY, taken deliberately (2026-07-26). A local embedding model is
//dep1: what makes a cold build $0.20 instead of $13.27 — it replaces ~190,000 model calls with
//dep2: arithmetic on this machine. It BREAKS 'zero runtime dependency'; it KEEPS 'nothing leaves',
//dep3: since the model runs here and only the weights ever arrive. transformers.js is pinned to
//dep4: its WASM backend in embed.ts: no native binary, so it cannot fail-to-install the way native
//dep5: deps do. The weights are NOT bundled — `npx stratless` runs mirror, which needs no model.
